notes.title: Closed beta update 0.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Added[/h1]

[list]
[*] Domination game mode on all maps.
[*] Advanced motion blur feature.
[*] New, more realistic scopes renderers.
[*] More immersive zero zones.
[*] Damage increase when inside of zero zones.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Glasshouse map rework.
[*] Oasis map rework.
[*] Fixed issue with decals which sometimes float in the camera view.
[*] Better explosion effects and sounds.
[*] PMC characters skins rework.
[*] Various weapons improvements.
[*] Reduced overall time to kill outside of zero zones.
[*] Other small improvements and adjustments to gameplay, graphics, and audio.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-alpha update 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Visuals for Zero Gravity Zones: bullet marks and particle effects.
[*] Unique first-person hands for each character corresponding to their third-person model.
[*] Skins are now applied correctly to all attachments.
[*] 3 new scopes: APK-8, APOG 4X, Mini Blue Dot.
[*] Depth of field effect when aiming.
[*] Plane flyby on Oasis as part of background immersion.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ragdolls are now more stable, dead character no longer 'freeze' in air.
[*] Unique first-person hands for each character corresponding to their third-person model.
[*] 3 new scopes: APK-8, APOG 4X, Mini Blue Dot.
[*] Depth of field effect when aiming.
[*] Reduced aimpunch (aim offset when getting shot).
[*] Reduced blood screen intensity when injured.
[*] Changed time to kill for all weapons to be 50% less (this is related to the next update where we'll introduce increased damage in Zero Gravity Fields).
[*] Reduced rechambering time for Kar108.
[*] Improved flashlight and laser sight.
[*] Various small bug fixes. 
[*] Improved graphics presets.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-alpha hot fix 0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Added:[/b]

[list]
[*] Upon death, jetpacks have a 50% chance of firing, propelling body upwards.
[*] New shooting sounds for M5A4 and AC-42.
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Laser sight and flashlight are now automatically enabled on spawn.
[*] Enabled better graphics settings on High and Ultra presets.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes 0.1.1
notes.content:
Small improvements and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] New map previews
[*] Lighting work on several maps
[*] Improvements to audio
[/list]
